description: Responsible for conducting field data collection, sample verification, and initial data validation for national statistical surveys.
Leads statistical modeling, index number compilation, time-series analysis, and sample design evaluation across government survey domains.
Processes large-scale survey datasets, performs automated data cleaning, generates tabulations, and prepares analytical statistical reports.
Manages survey logistics, field staff deployment, questionnaire design implementation, and data collection monitoring across districts.
Conducts applied statistical and economic research, national accounts estimation, macroeconomic indicator computation, and policy evaluation.
Applies machine learning, automated anomaly detection, and predictive analytics to government data streams and administrative registries.
Integrates spatial mapping, GIS boundaries, and remote sensing data with census and statistical sample survey frames.
Oversees database administration, secure data transmission, API integrations, and SDMX metadata standardization across technical platforms.
Ensures regulatory compliance, statistical confidentiality, data governance standards, and institutional record management.
Directs multi-disciplinary statistical projects, capacity development programs, resource allocations, and inter-departmental statistical coordination.
